# Apex Abstract & Title Status Dashboard — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build `Apex_Abstract_Status.html` — a self-contained offline dashboard showing RROG's title/abstract progress for Apex, section by section, ranked by frac-date urgency, generated by `build_abstract_dashboard.py` from Jolie Adams' monthly `Apex_Abstract Status Report_<date>.xlsx`.

**Architecture:** New code lives beside the existing RROG dashboard in `C:\GIS\CLIENT\RROG\DASHBOARD\` (its own disk-only git repo, HEAD `5633b36`), reusing the `rrog/` package (`geometry`, `abstract`, `assets`, `pdf_fallback`, `render` helpers) and `vendor/`. New: `rrog/abstract_report.py` (workbook → rung model), `rrog/abstract_diff.py` (prior-report diff), `abstract_template.html` (2-level shell), `rrog/abstract_render.py` (payload), `build_abstract_dashboard.py` (orchestrator + `CONFIGS`). The RROG dashboard and its 153-test suite must keep working — the `rrog/` package is only extended, never broken.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.13 on the ArcGIS Pro conda env (`C:\Program Files\ArcGIS\Pro\bin\Python\envs\arcgispro-py3\python.exe`) — `pandas`, `openpyxl`, `osgeo`, `PIL`, `pytest` all present. Leaflet 1.9.4 vendored/inlined. No new installs.

## Global Constraints

- **Interpreter:** always the ArcGIS Pro Python above (alias `PYEXE`). System Python has no GDAL / broken openpyxl.
- **Deliverable:** one file `C:\GIS\CLIENT\RROG\DASHBOARD\Apex_Abstract_Status.html`, opens by double-click, offline, no external requests except basemap tiles. Never `basemaps.cartocdn.com`.
- **Do not break the RROG build.** After every task: `"$PYEXE" -m pytest -q` must stay green (153 baseline + new tests), and `"$PYEXE" build_rrog_dashboard.py` must still produce `RROG_Dashboard.html`. `rrog/` modules are extended additively only.
- **Branding masthead:** RROG (primary) → "prepared for" Apex Natural Gas → "brought to you by" Mapmatics GIS. Reuse `vendor/rrog_logo.jpg` / `vendor/apex_logo.jpg` / `vendor/mm_logo.png`.
- **Canonical rung ladder:** `not_started → working → abstract_submitted → in_review → to_received`. Colours: `to_received` `#1B7A1B`, `in_review` `#0EA5A5`, `abstract_submitted` `#99FF99`, `working` `#FFA500`, `not_started` `#BFBFBF`, `3rd_party` hatched grey.
- **Section-key canonical form:** `<sec>-<twp>N-<rng>W` (e.g. `29-17N-12W`, `3-16N-13W`). `ALL SECTIONS` uses `<twp>N-<rng>W-<sec>` (`17N-12W-29`) — normalize.
- **`3rd Party - not assigned`** tracts: tagged, excluded from every % denominator.
- **`data/` is git-ignored** in the DASHBOARD repo — workbooks and shapefiles are working copies, not committed. `docs/abstract_build_report.md` is a git-ignored generated artifact (add to `.gitignore`).
- **Commits:** conventional messages, `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>` trailer, in the DASHBOARD repo (`C:\GIS\CLIENT\RROG\DASHBOARD\`, on `master`). The `permit_intel` `apex-abstract-dashboard` branch holds only the spec + this plan + a memory pointer.
- **Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-01-apex-abstract-status-dashboard-design.md` — read it, especially §3 (nav), §6 (rung model), §9 (traps).

All under `C:\GIS\CLIENT\RROG\DASHBOARD\`.

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `rrog/abstract_report.py` | Parse `Apex_Abstract Status Report.xlsx`: `parse_abstract_report(path) -> AbstractReport` (`AllSectionsRow` list + `{section: SectionAbstract}`; `SectionAbstract` carries header fields + `list[TractRung]`). `rung_of(...)` classifier. |
| `rrog/abstract_diff.py` | `diff_abstract(current: AbstractReport, prior: AbstractReport) -> dict` — per-tract rung advances, new abstracts, new TOs, section-status changes. |
| `rrog/abstract_render.py` | `abstract_payload(report, section_geoms, context) -> dict` + `render_abstract(template_path, payload, assets) -> str` (reuses `rrog.render._dumps` / sentinel + DEV_STUB strip helpers). |

| `docs/abstract_known_issues.md` | Tracked; consolidated deferred list for this dashboard. |

Dataclasses for `rrog/__init__.py` (paste verbatim, after the existing block):

```python
@dataclass
class TractRung:
    tract_id: str                # canonical, composite/range preserved verbatim as `key`
    key: str                     # the raw sheet tract cell ("3A&B", "6-52", "HH1-HH31")
    tract_ids: list              # expanded ids for the geometry join
    tract_name: str | None
    rung: str                    # not_started|working|abstract_submitted|in_review|to_received
    abstractor: str | None       # text after "WORKING -"
    abst_no: str | None
    abst_date: str | None        # ISO
    to_file_no: str | None
    to_date: str | None          # ISO
    tags: list = field(default_factory=list)   # "3rd_party","subdivision","estimate"
    raw: dict = field(default_factory=dict)    # {"submitted": ..., "to": ..., "trailing": ...}


@dataclass
class SectionAbstract:
    section: str                 # canonical "<sec>-<twp>N-<rng>W"
    parish: str | None
    abstractor: str | None
    title_attorney: str | None
    landman_instructions: str | None
    tracts: list                 # list[TractRung]
    rollup: dict                 # {rung: {"tracts": int, "pct": float}}
    title_complete_pct: float    # fraction of non-3rd-party tracts at to_received


@dataclass
class AllSectionsRow:
    section: str                 # canonical
    apex_unit: str | None
    landman: str | None
    date_assigned: str | None
    attorney: str | None
    changes_flag: bool           # CHANGES FROM LAST REPORT == YES
    status: str | None           # "WORKING" | "WORKING - HOLD PER TL" | "TITLE COMPLETE"
    spud_date: str | None        # ISO
    frac_date: str | None        # ISO


@dataclass
class AbstractReport:
    report_date: str             # ISO, from filename
    all_sections: list           # list[AllSectionsRow]
    sections: dict               # {canonical section: SectionAbstract}
    notes: list = field(default_factory=list)
```

from rrog.abstract_report import parse_abstract_report, rung_of, canon_section

def _wb():

@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw,expected", [

    ("16N-14W-36", "36-16N-14W"), ("Section 1 -15N-14W", "1-15N-14W"),
])
def test_canon_section(raw, expected):

## Task 2: Prior-report diff — `rrog/abstract_diff.py`

**Files:** Create `rrog/abstract_diff.py`, `tests/test_abstract_diff.py`.

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `diff_abstract(current: AbstractReport, prior: AbstractReport) -> dict`:
  ```python
  {"advanced":[{"section","tract","from","to"}], "new_abstracts":[{"section","tract","abst_no","abst_date"}],
   "new_tos":[{"section","tract","to_file_no","to_date"}], "section_status":[{"section","from","to"}],
   "added_sections":[section...], "removed_sections":[section...]}
  ```
- Rung order = the canonical ladder index; `to > from` in ladder index = advanced (never report regressions here — title work only moves forward; a rung going backward is a data correction, list it under a `"corrections"` key). Deterministic sort by (section, tract).

import json
from rrog.abstract_render import abstract_payload, section_boundary

## Task 4: Two-level template — `abstract_template.html`

**Files:** Create `abstract_template.html`, `tests/test_abstract_template.py` (structural asserts).

**Interfaces:**
- Tokens: `__PAYLOAD_JSON__`, `/*__LEAFLET_CSS__*/`, `/*__LEAFLET_JS__*/`, `__RROG_LOGO__`, `__APEX_LOGO__`, `__MM_LOGO__`, `__BUILD_STAMP__`.
- Level-1 view (`#view-overview`): masthead + the race table (sortable, default = `urgency`) + the all-sections Leaflet map (`all_sections_boundaries` coloured by `title_complete_pct` bucket / `status`). Row or polygon click → `showSection(key)`.
- Level-2 view (`#view-section`): back-to-overview control; header strip (abstractor, attorney, landman instructions, spud/frac, days-to-frac, status); rung-rollup bars (`rung_order` × `rung_color`); searchable per-tract table (rung chip, abstractor, Abst #, TO File #); section Leaflet map coloured by `properties.rung` (live) or `L.imageOverlay` / flat panel (image mode); tract click → detail card. A "Changes since last report" strip when `payload.change` is non-null.
- Leaflet mechanics + theme-token CSS + `localStorage` (namespaced `apxabs:`) copied from `template.html` with a `/* carried from RROG template.html */` comment. One shared `L.canvas`, pan-not-zoom on select, deferred `fitBounds` + `ResizeObserver`, keyless basemaps.
- A **minimal** `DEV_STUB` (1 overview row, 1 section, 2 tracts, placeholder names) so the file opens standalone; `render_abstract` strips it.
